messages:
Samir: Heads-up — Clarion (customer) just escalated a P1. We're seeing a spike in 5xx from the Dedicated pool serving clarion-v2 since ~02:10 UTC. CS says downtime risk for critical flows. Who can own immediate mitigation and a short timeline? :eyes:
Lena: I'm available. Quick question — is this spike across all seq lengths or only long-context jobs?
Samir: Early signs look heavy on long-context (>= 4096). p99 latency also rising. Logs show KV cache thrashing and OOMs on pool-7 nodes.
Kai: Assigning myself to mitigation. First step: divert new requests to clarion-v1 (compatible fallback) and disable long-context routing to dedicated for Clarion tenants.
Priya: I'll coordinate with CS for customer-facing messaging and get them the rollback plan ETA.
Samir: Kai — can you do the traffic cut and sync with eng-infra for a temporary scale-up? We should avoid a full rollback if possible.
Kai: On it. Plan: 1) update routing policy to pin clarion to clarion-v1 for new sessions (5m) 2) apply autoscale bump +2 nodes to pool-7 (10m) 3) patch serving runtime to disable large sequence KV prefetch for clarion (30m hotfix) 4) monitor 5xx and p99; rollback if 5xx not <0.5% within 20m.
Lena: I can prep the runtime patch PR and tag eng-infra for the autoscale change. PR will include the conditional: if tenant == "clarion" && seq_len > 4096 -> fallback to chunked mode.
Samir: Ping eng-infra: @oncall-bot can you run a quick capacity check for pool-7 and confirm we have +2 nodes available in the Dedicated cluster in us-west-2?
oncall-bot: Capacity check triggered by Samir at 1767774360. Result: 2 spare nodes available in us-west-2-dedicated. No pending maintenance windows.
Kai: Doing routing change now — executing rollout command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant clarion --src clarion-v2 --dest clarion-v1 --mode gradual --rate 100
```
Applying now, expected propagation 30s.
Lena: PR opened: github.com/redwood/serving/PR/8342 — patch and unit tests included. tagging @eng-infra for the autoscale API call.
Samir: Autoscale request submitted to infra Slack thread. ETA from infra is ~8 minutes to provision nodes.
Priya: Customer update sent: "We've detected elevated errors and are routing traffic to a compatible fallback while we stabilize. We're targeting a mitigation within 30 minutes and will follow up with exact timeline."
Kai: Routing switch completed. New request ratio to clarion-v1 ~100%. Observability: 5xx rate dropping but p99 still elevated.
Lena: Runtime patch merged to canary channel. Rolling to 10% of clarion traffic (canary id: c-clarion-001).
Kai: Autoscale completed, pool-7 +2 nodes live.
Samir: Good. Monitoring for the next 20m. If p99 doesn't improve after runtime patch full rollout, we may need a temporary quota on long-context jobs for clarion tenants (customer OK with short limits if it avoids downtime).
Priya: CS confirms customer will accept short-term seq_len caps for safety. They asked for an owner to confirm when we can remove caps.
Kai: I'll continue as primary owner. Action items: Kai (mitigation + revert if needed), Lena (runtime patch + deploy), eng-infra (autoscale + confirm capacity), Priya (CS comms). Target: full stabilization or safe cap within 30m.
Samir: Thanks. I'll update the incident tracker and ping legal if we need SLA abatements.
Priya: Noted. I'll log the timeline and follow up at 1767774520 with a status update to CS and execs.
Kai: Current status @ 1767774520 — 5xx down to 0.4%, p99 reduced from 2.3s -> 1.1s on the fallback; runtime canary showing memory improvement. Keeping caps disabled for now. Continuing monitoring. :thumbsup:
Samir: Closing loop — postmortem owners: Kai (mitigation), Lena (runtime fix), Priya (customer comms). We'll schedule follow-up async doc. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
